Name: Zombies Ruined My Day
Overview:
This is the story of how the best day of your life can become a nightmare full of zombies.

Survive in a hostile environment using all sorts of weapons. Defend your position with barricades, blow up groups of zombies with grenades, sweep the area away with a Gatling and more! All in a fully action packed game with colorful backgrounds and fearsome monsters.

Show us that you're more than a snack for zombies!
